Name: Busty Harriot (Harvey)
Author: SillyBobThorton
Description:
-WHAT THIS MOD CHANGES-

This is a conversion of StardewValley_Girl-byAdarin. It' a redone version of Harriot's portrait where you can now see her newly added ample breasts, It also comes with a new rockin' body for Harriot's character!  I made this as an alternative for people who like big boobies but don't want all the female characters running around nude all the time.  I do plan on making more mods similar to this for the other characters in the game.

-WHAT ARE THE DIFFERENT OPTIONS?-

There are 3 different options for the portrait and 2 for the body.

Portraits-
Option 1 Let's you see all of Harriot's head While cutting off the bottom of the breasts a bit.
Option 2 Is a middle ground where you can see more of Harriot's breasts but her head is cut off a bit.  (This is my favorite version)
Option 3 Captures all of Harriot's magnificent boobage while cropping out the top of her head.  (This might actually be my favorite version...)

Characters (Body)-
Option 1 Is a version of Harriot where she does not have glasses on.  While this version is less lore friendly, you might find that Harriot is much more appealing to look at (my favorite version)
Option 2 Is the normal version of Harriot where her glasses can be seen on her character while she roams around in game.

-RECOMMENDED MODS-

I highly recommend using StardewValley_Girl-byAdarin along with this since the face model for female Harvey was designed by them originally and there are multiple other characters that they have converted.  I would also recommend using Dialogue Changes Full for 1.1 by KeionDryke so that everyone in the game refers to Harvey as Harriot.  Also, if you like the portraits but not the sprites (or visa versa) then you can always download Adarin's version and mix and match.

-INSTALLATION-

Portrait-
Take the Harvey.xnb file and put it in your (Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits) folder.  It will ask you to overwrite, click yes.  This will replace Harvey's default portrait set with the new busty female Harriot one.  Make sure to save a copy of your old Harvey.xnb file somewhere to keep as a backup.

Character-
Take the Harvey.xnb file and put it in your (Stardew Valley\Content\Characters) folder.  It will ask you to overwrite, click yes.  This will replace Harvey's default character sprite with the new busty female Harriot one.  Make sure to save a copy of your old Harvey.xnb file somewhere to keep as a backup
